verdict.rationale: Forter ships a Forter3DS SDK for iOS and Android, so 3DS authentication is part of the product, and the order API returns risk decisions at checkout. Nothing in the evidence shows that those decisions drive SCA routing, meaning triggering 3DS only when required or risky and requesting exemptions when safe. Missing for 10: documented SCA/PSD2 exemption requests (e.g. TRA, low-value), risk-based 3DS triggering logic tied to Forter decisions, European/PSD2-specific routing documentation, and independent or hands-on corroboration of conversion and compliance outcomes.
